criteria.name: timed_aggregate_cpu_within_seventy_percent_of_baseline
criteria.description: The aggregate call on the timed extract is exact and uses at most 70 percent of the baseline CPU time.

criteria.name: aggregate_function_matches_reference
criteria.description: The module function aggregate, imported and called on one request log of held-out extract 0, returns the documented result object.

criteria.name: shipped_frozen_files
criteria.description: The nine frozen files left in /app/out equal the shipped settlement exactly.

criteria.name: shipped_verifier_run
criteria.description: A verifier run on the shipped extract writes every report exactly, its manifest matches the reports it wrote, and the printed result line of one shipped request log is canonical and exact.

criteria.name: except_clauses_name_a_class
criteria.description: Every except clause of /app/out/optimize.py names an exception class and does not discard the error (counted only when every shipped artifact is exact).

criteria.name: functions_at_most_fifty_lines
criteria.description: Every function of /app/out/optimize.py is at most 50 lines long (counted only when every shipped artifact is exact).

criteria.name: negative_hardcoded_sample_answers
criteria.description: Shipped answers are written into the program or replayed on a held-out extract.

criteria.name: negative_reads_outside_scope
criteria.description: The program opens a file outside DATA_DIR, OUT_DIR and its own folder.

criteria.name: negative_forbidden_facility
criteria.description: The program connects a socket, starts a process, reads the current time, or uses random, uuid, secrets, a third-party module or a module from its own folder.

criteria.name: negative_location_dependent_output
criteria.description: Reports change with the extract path, working directory or output directory.

criteria.name: negative_writes_outside_out_dir
criteria.description: The program modifies the extract or writes outside OUT_DIR.

criteria.name: negative_nondeterministic_output
criteria.description: Two runs at the same location give different reports.
